title: राष्ट्रिय हित प्रर्बद्घनमा सैनिक–नागरिक सम्बन्धको महत्व
nepali: नेपालको सार्वभौमसत्ता, अखण्डता, सिमाना सुरक्षा र नेपाली जनताको रक्षार्थ नेपाली सेनाले अग्र भागमा रहेर महत्व पूर्ण भुमिका निर्वाह गर्दै आएको छ । नेपाली सेनाको कार्य सम्पादन गर्ने शैली र कार्य व्यवहारले गर्दा नेपाली जनताहरु माझ विश्वासिलो संस्थाको रुपमा स्थापित छ । नेपालको एकीकरण अभियान, पहिलो र दोस्रो विश्वयुद्ध, नेपाल–भोट युद्ध, खम्पा प्रकरण निष्तेज प्रक्रिया, नाकाबन्दी समस्या अन्त्यका लागि खेल्दै आएको भूमिका, प्राकृतिक प्रकोप, कोभिड–१९ जस्तो प्राणघातक महामारी लगायतमा नेपाली जनतालाई केन्द्रमा राखेर सक्रिय सहभागी भई समस्या न्यूनीकरण एवं समाधानार्थ सक्दो प्रयत्न गर्दैआएको पाइन्छ । यसका लागि नियमानुसार नेपाली समाजका सदस्यहरु नेपाली सेनामा भर्ना भइ देश र जनताको सेवामा काम गर्दै आउनु नै ‘सैनिक नागरिक सम्बन्ध’ को घनत्वलाई प्रस्ट्याएको देखिन्छ । नेपाली सेनाका सदस्यहरुको व्यवहार कस्तो छ वा हुनुपर्छ भन्ने विषयलाई नेपालीसमाजको वनावट, प्रकृति र प्रशासनिक स्वरुपले निर्धारण गर्नुका साथै समाजबाटै आएका विभिन्न सदस्यहरुको सङ्गठन भएकाले सेनाको मनोवृत्तिर कार्य–व्यवहारमा पनि सामाजिक प्रवृत्तिकै गहिरोछाप परेको हुन्छ । नेपालको राष्ट्रिय हित प्रबद्र्धनका लागि सैनिक नागरिक सम्बन्धको महत्व अवलोकन गर्नु नै यो लेखको मुख्य उद्देश्य हो । सैनिक–नागरिक सम्बन्धलाई सैद्धान्तिक, वैज्ञानिक र व्यावहारिक रुपमा अगाडि बढाउन सैनिक–नागरिक सम्बन्धको सिद्धान्त,राष्ट्रिय तथा अन्तराष्ट्रिय षड्यन्त्रको सिद्धान्तलाई ख्याल गरी आदर्शवादी–यथार्थवादी सिद्धान्तको कसीमा राखेर सैनिक–नागरिक सम्बन्धलाई हेर्नुपर्ने आवश्यकता छ । यो लेख वर्णनात्मक, विश्लेषणात्मक र तुलनात्मक शैलीमा आधारित छ । यसका साथै स्थलगत कार्य अन्तर्गत सम्बन्ध स्रोत व्यक्तिहरु सँग अन्तर्वार्ता पनि लिइएको छ । सैनिक–नागरिक सन्दर्भका नव प्रवर्तनात्मक खोजहरुले वर्तमान आवश्यकतानुसार राष्ट्रिय हित प्रबद्र्धनमा सैनिक–नागरिक सम्बन्धको महत्व विशिष्ट रहेको देखाउँछ ।
american_english: The Nepali Army has continually played an important role at the forefront for the protection of Nepal's sovereignty, integrity, border security, and the Nepali people. Owing to the Nepali Army's style of performance and work conduct, it stands established as a trustworthy institution among the Nepali people. Across the unification campaign of Nepal, the First and Second World Wars, the Nepal–Tibet War, the process of neutralizing the Khampa affair, the role played in ending the blockade problem, natural disasters, and fatal pandemics like COVID-19, it is found to have kept the Nepali people at the center, actively participating and making every effort toward problem minimization and resolution. For this, members of Nepali society being enlisted in the Nepali Army according to regulations and continually working in service of the country and the people is what clearly illustrates the density of 'civil-military relations.' Along with the composition, nature, and administrative setup of Nepali society determining what the conduct of members of the Nepali Army is or ought to be, because it is an organization of diverse members coming from society itself, a deep imprint of social tendencies is also left on the military's attitude and working behavior. Observing the importance of civil-military relations for the promotion of Nepal's national interest is the main objective of this article. To advance civil-military relations theoretically, scientifically, and practically, taking into account civil-military relations theory and national and international conspiracy theories, there is a need to examine civil-military relations against the touchstone of idealist-realist theory. This article is based on descriptive, analytical, and comparative styles. In addition to this, interviews were also conducted with relevant resource persons under fieldwork. Innovative findings in the context of civil-military relations show that the importance of civil-military relations in promoting national interest according to contemporary needs is distinct.

informal_english: The Nepali Army has always been right at the forefront playing a major role in protecting Nepal's sovereignty, integrity, border security, and the Nepali people. Thanks to the way the Nepali Army gets things done and conducts its work, it's firmly established as a trustworthy institution among everyday Nepali people. Across Nepal's unification campaign, the First and Second World Wars, the Nepal–Tibet War, defusing the Khampa affair, the role played in putting an end to border blockades, natural disasters, and deadly pandemics like COVID-19, it's consistently kept the Nepali people front and center, actively pitching in and doing everything possible to reduce and resolve problems. For this, having members of Nepali society enlist in the army by the book and serve the country and its people is what really shows the depth of 'military-civilian relations.' Along with the makeup, nature, and administrative setup of Nepali society deciding what the conduct of army members is or ought to be, because it's an organization made up of diverse members coming straight from society, a deep imprint of social habits is left on the military's attitude and day-to-day behavior too. Checking out the importance of military-civilian relations for promoting Nepal's national interest is the main point of this article. To move military-civilian relations forward theoretically, scientifically, and practically, while keeping in mind civil-military theory and national and international conspiracy theories, there's a real need to look at military-civilian relations against the touchstone of idealist-realist theory. This article is based on descriptive, analytical, and comparative styles. On top of that, interviews were also done with relevant resource people as part of fieldwork. Innovative findings around military-civilian relations show that the importance of civil-military relations in promoting national interest to meet today's needs is especially standout.
